facts.value: Resets Mewtwo's retained Disable and Shadow Ball references, stored Shadow Ball charge, and Confusion aerial-boost latch at the death boundary. Clearing the latch restores boost eligibility, but that eligibility is not once per life: Confusion's air-to-ground transition also clears the latch.
facts.rationale: Preserves the demonstrated death reset while correcting the baseline's once-per-life claim using the cross-file landing reset.

evidence.why: False latch permits and then records the aerial boost.
Air-to-ground Confusion clears the latch independently of death.
